description: This file defines the SectionStorageManager class, which manages plugin instances for section storage in Drupal's layout builder module. It includes methods for loading, finding, and checking support for different section storage types, and interacts with cache and context handling components.

classes.name: SectionStorageManager
classes.description: Manages plugin instances for section storage, providing methods to load, find, and verify support for different storage types within Drupal's layout builder.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SectionStorageManager with necessary dependencies, sets up plugin namespace, cache, and context handling.

methods.name: findDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts plugin definitions based on their weight.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific section storage plugin by type and applies context mapping.

methods.name: findByContext
methods.description: Finds a suitable section storage plugin based on provided contexts and cacheability dependencies.

methods.name: loadEmpty
methods.description: Creates an empty instance of a section storage plugin by type.

methods.name: notSupported
methods.description: Checks if any plugin supports a given entity type, bundle, and view mode; returns true if none support it.
